question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Absurd
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sensible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Absurd **means ridiculous, illogical, or unreasonable. (विवेकहीन)

 
 
• **Example**: *The idea of using a toaster to dry your wet clothes seems utterly absurd and impractical*.
 
 
 
• Marked option **Sensible **means practical, rational, or logical. (समझदार)
 
 
• **Example**: *It's sensible to wear a coat when the temperature drops to ensure you stay warm during the winter months.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of a word is a word that means the opposite of the given word.
 
• Therefore, sensible is the most appropriate antonym for absurd.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tolerable **means bearable or acceptable. (संतोषजनक)
 
• **Adorable **means cute, lovable, or charming. (प्यारा)
 
• **Lovable **means endearing or affectionate. (प्यार करने योग्य)
